03 / A message from your girl

READ THIS
WHEN YOU PIT.

Happy Birthday, My Favourite Racer! 🖤🏁

To the boy who loves speed, bikes, cars, mud rallies, racing and everything that gives him an adrenaline rush…

And somehow, became the biggest reason behind the fastest heartbeat of my life. ❤️

Who knew that one random car ride on 11th October 2025 would become the beginning of something so special? I still find it crazy how life brings two people together in the most unexpected ways. And then came 3rd December, our first proper face-to-face meeting at KD — a memory that will always have a special place in my heart.

You know, you have your own world. A world full of engines, roaring exhausts, muddy tracks, crazy speeds, beautiful machines, dark themes and monsters. A world where a BMW S1000 or a Duke 390 can instantly make your eyes light up.

And honestly? I don't just want to admire that world from a distance. I want to be a part of it.

I want to be your co-driver on every crazy road trip, your pillion on every bike ride, the person sitting beside you when you chase your dreams, and the one waiting for you at the finish line, no matter whether you win or lose.

I want to experience every adventure with you — the long rides, the unexpected turns, the crazy plans, the muddy roads and even the moments when we have absolutely no idea where we're going.

Because for me, it's never really about the destination. It's always about who's riding beside me. And I want that person to be YOU. 🏍️

I love how caring and loving you are, how you show your affection in your own little ways, and yes, even that habit of claiming your rights over almost everything when it comes to me. Sometimes you can be such a stubborn little monster, but you're my favourite monster. 🖤

I know I can't promise you a life without difficult roads, unexpected turns or red signals. But I can promise that I'll always try to be the person who stands beside you through them.

I'll cheer for you when you race, pray for you when you're on the road, celebrate every little victory of yours and remind you to take care of yourself even when you're too busy chasing speed.

And one more thing, my love…

You might be obsessed with horsepower, torque, speed and machines, but I hope you know that you've got a girl whose heart races just a little faster whenever it's about you.

If life is a long road, I don't want to know how fast we can go. I just want to know that we're going together.

So here's to another year of your life, more adventures, more victories, more crazy rides, more dreams coming true and countless memories waiting for us.

Keep chasing your passion. Keep being the crazy, loving, caring, adventurous boy I fell for. Never lose that spark in your eyes when you talk about the things you love.

And someday, I hope we look back at this birthday and smile at how far we've travelled together.

Happy Birthday, Baby. ❤️

Your biggest fan, your future co-driver, your forever pillion and the girl who wants to be beside you in every ride, every race and every chapter of life.

I love you more than words could ever explain.

Ride safe. Race hard. Dream big. And always remember, someone is waiting to ride through life with you. One day, it'll be your workshop, your machines, your rules and the life we've always imagined. And I hope we'll look at it all and say, "We really made it." 🖤🏁🏍️

Your forever co-driver. ♥
